### Hello world! This is Claire Margaret speaking...
:::

*Senior @ U.C. Santa Cruz* 

Python | Java | Quarto | Photoshop | DaVinci Resolve | Art

*****

Hi there! :>
I'm a curiosity-driven fun-loving human who loves the small details of things. I'm passionate about 
expression, and want everything I create to have an air of care and authenticity you can feel. I 
have a knack for self-teaching, and can pick up new skills quickly because of that.
Throughout my time in college, I have had much experience in creating games through rapid 
prototyping techniques. I have created games for both classes and out of personal passion, and have 
learned that my favorite parts of design are ideating, inventing & implementing unique mechanics, 
and audio & visual design. I thrive in both independent and teamwork settings, as I am a creative 
thinker, good listener, and excellent team leader.
In my free time, you'll find me editing videos, creating wacky scenes in Photoshop, baking 
snickerdoodles, at the local metal scene, or skateboarding somewhere new.
